content.caption:
Why do some people think AI can write an entire novel while others think it's just an overhyped spell-checker?

The gap in what people actually think LLMs can do is widening faster than ever. Half the internet treats them like sci-fi oracles, while the other half thinks they are glorified text-predicting toys.

The truth sits quietly in the middle, and missing it means you are either wasting time or leaving massive productivity gains on the table 🤖
